rules: Read metadata and bounded headers/current target rows before each write.
Preserve existing headers, row data, formulas, dropdowns, formatting and unrelated tabs.
Inspect validation before selecting status values; do not invent new status labels or columns.
Do not create or export a local job_tracker.xlsx.
Never infer APPLIED from finding a job or generating files; require observed submission confirmation.
Fitness is an explained fit assessment, not an ATS score or hiring probability. No minimum-score rewriting loop.
Use verified durable artifact URLs when available; otherwise clearly label a local artifact path rather than fabricate a hosted link.
Do not store passwords, OTPs or unrelated email content.
